_comment: Who is on this round, how to reach them, and what they own. Read by
scripts/board.py who. Address peers by SOCKET, never by name: session names
collide -- 'lessons-44' resolves to at least two live sessions and only one is
on this team. On 2026-09-01 three non-team sessions were given work because an
idle status in ListAgents was read as ownership. Idle does not derive
membership; a produced artifact or the session's own word does.
Post to a topic and everyone sees it. Send a socket message and only one does.

2026-09-05 fb: ADDRESSING STANDARD. Send to the socket in this file, or to listagents_name with its [ref] appended -- never a bare name. Names collide (lessons-e1 is NOT e1; lessons-23/c1 are not on this team) and the channel a grant commit names (e.g. 'via tilerl-27') is a grant channel, never the runner. Before the first send of a session, run ListAgents and match name+ref against this file; if they disagree, this file is updated first. A misrouted message goes back to its sender, and the sender re-reads this file. Incidents: 2026-09-01 three non-team sessions dispatched; 2026-09-05 b0's bench review sent to tilerl-27 then to a session outside the team.
